eligibility.quote:
Observed results:
the rospy listener receives messages correctly; the roscpp listener does not

failed_conditions.quote:
I am currently looking at the code. It is definitely an issue in the modified code of `TransportTCP::connect()`.

A simple scenario to reproduce is:
- three shells A, B and C
- A and B which normal ROS groovy environment
- C with ROS_IP set to the ip of the machine
- A: `roscore`
- C: `rosrun ros(cpp|py)_tutorials talker`
- B: `rosrun roscpp_tutorials listener`

B is not receiving any messages from C.

loudness.quote:
With the roscpp nodes running in this setup, rosnode info /talker doesn't show any outgoing connections, but rosnode info /listener indicates that it's connected.

I would guess that this means that the subscriber is receiving the list of publishers properly, but isn't setting up the TCP connection for the topic.

resolution.quote: Fixed, look for ros_comm v1.9.37 to come out.

notes: Independently verified this session. (1) Eligibility: ros_comm #35 (ahendrix, 2012-12-14, 'roscpp subscribers don't connect properly when using ROS_IP/ROS_HOSTNAME') body read in full: two-machine reproducer and all quoted sentences verified verbatim, including 'It only appears to be a problem with roscpp subscribers; rospy subscribers are unaffected' and 'setups which don't use ROS_IP or ROS_HOSTNAME on the publisher are also unaffected'. All six comments verified (hershwg id 11361650 naming 8f60630 as suspect; ahendrix id 11361752; hershwg id 11361946 'I have just confirmed that this bug exists in 1.9.34 but does not exist in 1.9.32.'; bit-pirate id 11362002; dirk-thomas id 11396370; schneider42 id 11398553 'Thanks for fixing it. I obviously misused the inet_pton function there.'). turtlebot #39 verified (jihoonl 2012-12-13 title/body, ahendrix link comment, stonier closure). Peer-dependence test applied correctly: hostname-advertising peers work, so not internal; interface kind wire protocol field (endpoint host) is right; PAIR is right. (2) Condition: class 'other' agrees — I read both the introducing diff (8f606302, 2012-11-21, 'merge modified patch provided by @schneider42 - Initial IPv6 support for roscpp (fix #7)') and the fix diff (eab0d3c, parent 475b969c): at 1.9.34 inet_pton wrote the address into (sockaddr_in*)&sas where sin_family/sin_port live and family/port were then written over it, and the second branch repeated AF_INET instead of AF_INET6; the protocol permits both hostname and IP-literal forms and the publisher's value is correct, so this is a consumer-side parsing defect triggered by one legal form of the field, not a representation mismatch between units. Implicating api:requestTopic and topic:/chatter is defensible. (3) Loudness silent_documented/run: no diagnostic shown; the documented symptom is connected-but-no-messages. (4) Resolution recommended: fix commit verified (message, date, diff); eab0d3c confirmed contained in tag 1.9.37 via compare API (ahead_by 1, behind_by 0); tag 1.9.34 resolves to 7d27fabb as spec states; no working observation of the resolved composition in the source (bit-pirate's test request unanswered), so recommended, not observed. ros_tutorials groovy-devel head verified 0d771e72d06eda215da9eac3f907de9bb82dea94, matching the spec's basis.
